learning_notes: Cannabis product type now uses a priority decision tree: synthetic agonists/antagonists and pharma-isolated compounds are detected before broad labels like vape pen or unknown — and vape pen only fires on explicit device terms, not vapor inhalation alone.

Strain, dose, and schedule fields parse Methods text shared across node2a/2b/2c: cultivar codes (CN2/CN4), supplier-qualified compounds, mg/kg THC/CBD (with µg/kg conversion), gestational-day ranges, and phrases like twice daily.
Exposure route logic prefers oral/edible when food-delivery cues appear near THC/CBD mentions, so injection keywords in background text no longer override edible administration.
Maude classify_paper now forwards all downstream extraction fields (mg/kg doses, administration frequency, inhaled session duration, etc.) so PDF A/B batches score the full node2 field scope.

Adjacent node2 branches inherit the same extractor.py logic and shared extraction_cues in maude_cues.json — clinical trials and in vitro papers benefit from the same dose/duration/strain parsers without separate handoffs.
Re-scored the same 20 pdf_extracted holdout papers on deployed Fly code; refresh batch calibration_20260622_161904_043 reproduced 66.2% alignment and 49.9% Maude recall — classifier output is stable.

Compared to the pre-PDF pass on identical paper IDs (153659 subset): alignment 65.0%→66.2% (+1.2pp), Maude recall 37.2%→49.9% (+12.7pp). Most recall gain came from loading full PDF Methods text, not a second code patch.
Only one Maude codebase update has been applied so far (handoff 151932 in extractor.py / maude_classifier.py / maude_cues.json). Staged patch 154633 remains unimplemented.
PDF download succeeded on 19/20 papers; one bioinformation.net link failed SSL verification and fell back to abstract-only extraction.
90% alignment gate is still not met on this holdout — next step is applying feedback patch 154633 or a new disagreement-driven handoff, then re-measuring this same paper set.

handoffs.summary_title: Node 2b patch 154633 — temporal extractors, strain, exposure routing
learning_notes: Expanded administration_frequency and duration_days parsers: weekly/alternating/on-off schedules, explicit for-N-days, over-N-weeks, and PND/postnatal day ranges.
strain_reported now merges animal strains (Sprague-Dawley, C57BL/6J, …) with synthetic test articles (CP-55940, WIN55212, JWH/AM series) and vendor-proximate isolated THC/CBD labels.
In vivo exposure routing prefers oral/edible cues before injection; unqualified vapor/smoke in rodents defaults to nose-only rather than whole-body chamber.
Added extract_thc_mg_ml for inhalation papers and tightened inhaled session duration regex (N-min vapor/smoke/inhalation session).
node1 routing override sends in vivo + animal-species abstracts to original research before review title cues fire; maude_cues.json documents temporal/strain/routing cue groups.

handoffs.summary_title: Node 2b patch 163733 — compound provenance, exposure guards, dose parsing
learning_notes: strain_reported uses dual-target logic: animal catalog strains win when present; otherwise pure-cannabinoid papers populate compound provenance (catalog id + vendor + purity) instead of null or vendor-catalog noise.

Exposure routing checks dissolved-in-media bath/immersion cues before injection; injection only fires when explicit route abbreviations (i.p., i.v., s.c., …) appear near cannabinoid mentions — removing the injection default fallback.
cannabis_type edibles tag requires explicit product phrases; Sigma/Cayman/Tocris/NIDA/THC Pharm vendor cues override dietary delivery to pure cannabinoid.

duration_days captures following/after N days, N days of treatment, and week-to-day conversion; mg/kg/day parsing fills thc_mg_kg/cbd_mg_kg; administration_frequency no longer invents once-daily defaults (normalizes to daily).
dose_mg only accepts explicit absolute-dose phrasing — mg/kg-only papers leave dose_mg null while populating mg/kg fields.

handoffs.summary_title: Node 2c patch 165531 — in-vitro duration, strain blocklist, analytical routing
learning_notes: First node2c RL cycle on 20 pdf_extracted in-vitro papers (75.4% alignment baseline). treatment_duration now captures incubation hours, MD simulation ns/us runtimes, and storage-day phrases — preferring the shortest acute window when multiple durations appear.

strain_reported prioritizes cv./chemovar/chemotype labels and filters reagent vendor/catalog tokens; pure-cannabinoid compound provenance still includes vendors when explicitly tagged pure cannabinoid (node2b-compatible).

Analytical/computational pre-routing guard (UHPLC, HPLC, HRMS, docking, GROMACS) forces Cell Culture (Other In Vitro) before clinical observational fallback; outcome_domain expanded for oncology cell-biology, GIRK/pain, and receptor-internalization addiction cues.
THC/CBD percent extractors reject acid-fraction ratio contexts and enforce plant-content ceilings (≤40% THC, ≤25% CBD); isolated cannabinoids without plant-matrix language map to pure cannabinoid.
Shared extractor.py changes inherit to node2a/2b where applicable; node2c-specific cues documented under extraction_cues.node2c_invitro in maude_cues.json.

handoffs.summary_title: Node 2c targeted handoff — treatment_duration + strain_reported on same holdout
learning_notes: Same 20-paper node2c holdout; focused on diverging characteristic fields only (treatment_duration 17/20 disagree, strain_reported 18/20 disagree after patch 165531).

treatment_duration replaces shortest-first with context scoring: incubation/treatment/viability windows beat prep-step minutes; 24 h preference rank resolves multi-match PDFs; MD 'simulated during N ns' and hour-to-day ranges supported; full-PDF fallback when Methods omit simulation runtime.

strain_reported adds in-vitro priority path: chemotype I/II/III profiles, cv. quoted names, 331-18A/CBDV panels, compound panels (CP55,940/WIN/AEA/SR141716), botanical alternative sources; suppresses ethics-only animal strains and bare THC/CBD vendor tokens in cell-culture context.

Greedy cultivar/variety regex and isolated-from captures tightened to block PDF noise (e.g. 'cultivar yields…', PLGA fragments); extended cultivar codes limited to 331-* series in Cannasoul purchase sentences.
classify_paper forwards full_text to extract_all_heuristics for duration/strain fallbacks beyond Methods isolation.

handoffs.summary_title: Node 2b patch 171929 — invivo strain/species guards, temporal extractors, routing
learning_notes: 10-paper node2b PDF holdout RL cycle: feedback disagreements implemented as code (not verification-only refresh).
Stopped node2c invitro strain bleed on mixed papers: null strain/species/duration when cell-culture dominates without mg/kg in-vivo dosing.
In-vivo strain priority returns synthetic test articles (CP-55,940/WIN/O-1602) or named cultivar THC/CBD profiles without animal-vendor stacking.
Administration frequency normalizes whitespace/twice-a-week; sample_size prefers largest N; duration_days skips incubation windows.
Exposure routing prefers whole-body chamber over nose-only; publication routing uses full PDF prefix to avoid review misclassification on prenatal/primate studies.
run_subnode_calibration.sh now triggers feedback cycle after batch pull (RUN_FEEDBACK=1 default).
